name: Korsan Hazinesi
scene: A parrot watches a pirate sailing ship above an open treasure chest amid flowing ocean waves.
notes: Design sheet only. Target 110–160 panes. Warm pair identifies parrot, ship, chest and treasure; cool pair identifies sky and sea. Generated with the old grand_20 image as subject reference and vitray_lighthouse / vitray_hotairballoon as style references. Inspected initial image and regenerated once to remove transparent exterior, sun, gray ship pane, line overshoots and crowded sky crossings. Final image inspected: opaque white exterior, closed oval rim, clear subjects and improved T junctions. Remaining doubts for tracing: slight fill tonal variation; narrow mast, chest rim and coin-edge panes; small inter-coin gaps; some same-colour adjoining subject pieces and dense contacts around feathers/coins may merge or need geometry review. Pane count is a design target, not a verified traced count.
